description_en: Queries the Java processes that are collected by the asset fingerprints feature of Security Center in your assets
description_zh: 查询云安全中心资产指纹调查功能在您资产中采集到的Java进程列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-property-sca-process-detail --remark 10.167.XX.XX --uuid D0D6E6E4-CB8C-4897-B852-46AEFDA00000 --pid 756 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --cmdline java_-jar --biz-type java --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePropertyScaProcessDetail

parameters.help_en: The information about the server that you want to query. The value can be the public IP address, private IP address, or name of the server. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的资产信息，可以设置为资产名称、公网IP或私网IP（支持模糊查询）
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server.



You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
服务器UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数。
只支持精确查询
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The process ID.

Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
进程ID。
只支持精确查询
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. If you leave this parameter empty, 10 entries are returned on each page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为10条，pagesize参数值为空时，将默认返回10条数据。
建议pagesize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The startup parameter.

This parameter supports only prefix queries. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
启动参数。
该参数只支持前缀查询，不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: cmdline

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application process. Default value: java. Valid values:

java: Java process.
php: PHP process
parameters.help_zh:
应用进程类型，默认为java。取值：

java：java进程
php：php进程
parameters.name: biz_type

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的进程的数量。默认值为10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Propertys.description_en: The processes collected by the asset fingerprints feature

Cmdline.description_en: The command line of the process

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp at which the last asset fingerprint collection is performed. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 资产指纹的最新扫描的时间戳。单位为毫秒

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the server

InstanceName.description_en: The instance name of the server

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server

Version.description_en: The version of web application service

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
